name: limit-bars
description: Shows your 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt, along with how long the prompt cache stays warm. Asks before a send that would cost more because the cache has gone cold.

style.title: Style
style.description: bar or ring for the 5-hour and weekly limits. Rings only in the desktop app; the terminal keeps bars. Also /bars style.

showFiveHour.title: 5-hour limit
showFiveHour.description: Show the 5-hour usage limit. Without one, the weekly pace. Also /bars 5h on|off.

showWeekly.title: Weekly limit
showWeekly.description: Show the weekly usage limit. Also /bars week on|off.

showCache.title: Cache ring
showCache.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm. The cold-send question works without it. Also /bars cache on|off.

showCost.title: Cost ring
showCost.description: This chat's share of the project cost. Needs cost-ledger. Also /bars cost on|off.

showSystem.title: System values
showSystem.description: CPU, RAM, GPU and GPU memory, measured every second. Windows only. Also /bars cpu on|off.

storagePath.title: Storage drive
storagePath.description: Drive shown as a ring, e.g. E:. Empty: no ring. Windows only.

showStorage.title: Storage ring
showStorage.description: Show the drive ring when a storage drive is set. Also /bars storage on|off.

askBeforeColdSend.title: Ask before a cold send
askBeforeColdSend.description: Asks before a message rewrites a big chat into a cold cache, with the cost of both ways. Also /cache warn on|off.

expiryNotice.title: Notice before the cache expires
expiryNotice.description: A short notice shortly before the cache of a big idle chat goes cold. Also /cache hints on|off.

bigTokens.title: Big chat from (tokens)
bigTokens.description: The cold-send question and the notice only apply from this context size. Also /cache big.

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime (min)
cacheTtl.description: auto: measured from the last request, otherwise 60. Also /cache ttl.

resetStyle.title: Reset time
resetStyle.description: mixed: 5 hours as a countdown, week as a clock time. clock or countdown: both alike.

highlightAt.title: Bold from (%)
highlightAt.description: From this usage the limit's label and percentage turn bold.

onlyFiveHour.title: Old: 5-hour limit only
onlyFiveHour.description: Replaced by Weekly limit and switched off at the next start. On: the weekly limit is hidden.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the texts and of the model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /bars language.
